CONFIDENTIAL AGENTS’ COMMUNICATION
Date of Issue: 4th August 2026
‘B O R N F R E E’
(2027 Sarova Shaba Ground Package)
Softly imposing on the semi-desert Shaba Game Reserve, Sarova Shaba Game Lodge welcomes its
guest to "Born Free Country". Offering the rare opportunity to see the bounty of unique wildlife such as
the Grevy Zebra and the Reticulated Giraffe and the Beisy Oryx.
Shaba Area was made famous by Joy and George Adamson's true-life story film ‘Born Free’
